offence: Breach of Article B4.1.1 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 27 (Nico Hulkenberg), the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio, timing and in-car video evidence. Video showed that Car 27 was driving slowly on the racing line on the approach to turn 5. Car 55 arrived from behind on a push lap and had to abandon the lap. That Car 55 was thereby impeded was not in dispute. The issue was whether Car 55 had been 'unnecessarily' impeded. The team stated in the hearing that they believed, based on timing information to which they subscribed, sourced from the official timekeeping provider, that Car 55 had already taken the chequered flag and conveyed that information to the driver by radio. Therefore the driver of Car 27 did not expect Car 55 to still be on a push lap when it was closing in. The Stewards acknowledge the fact that the data referenced by the team led the team to reasonably believe that Car 55 had received the chequered flag. Indeed, it was evident from Car 55's radio messages that its team had formed the same belief relying on the same data. The misunderstanding was revealed to be attributable to the information initially received by the teams not being fully synchronised and only being displayed in a correct manner after a short period of time. However, that post-processing did not occur until Car 55 arrived behind Car 27 depriving the team of any reasonable opportunity to correct the information conveyed to the driver. In the Stewards' assessment, because the source of the data upon which the team relied was the official timing provider, it was not unreasonable for the team to have relied upon it, even though the team also had available to it the official timing data which conflicted. The Stewards On the objective facts, the Stewards determined that Car 55 was unnecessarily impeded. However, there were extraordinary mitigating circumstances in this case because the incident was attributable to the team's reliance on information that was, for a brief period, inconsistent.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations

title: Infringement Car 27 Impeding Of Car 55
